title: Intrinsic finite-coefficient constructibility under nonseparated finite-type pushforward
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be schemes of finite type over $k$, and let $f:X	o Y$ be a $k$-morphism; separatedness is not assumed [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $B$ be a finite commutative ring and let $m\geq1$ be an integer with $mB=0$ and with $m$ invertible in $k$. Use the constant finite coefficient sheaves and the small etale and pro-etale derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], the site comparison $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and ordinary total derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Suppose $C\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ has only finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves and each is intrinsically constructible: a finite partition into locally closed constructible subschemes makes it locally constant with finite $B$-module stalks [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Then there is $L\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and an isomorphism $
u_X^*L\cong C$. The canonical comparison gives an isomorphism $
u_Y^*Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L\cong Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C$, and $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}C$ has only finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, all intrinsically constructible. No finite Tor amplitude is assumed.

proof.text: The field $k$ is Noetherian: its only ideals are $(0)$ and $(1)$; $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is locally Noetherian and is a one-point, hence quasi-compact, space. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] to $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ to make $X$ Noetherian. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian], every open subscheme of $X$ is quasi-compact. In particular the preimage of any affine open of $Y$ under $f$ is quasi-compact, so $f$ is quasi-compact. Likewise, the preimage of any affine open of $X\times_YX$ under $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ is an open subscheme of $X$ and therefore quasi-compact. Thus $\Delta_f$ is quasi-compact and $f$ is quasi-separated. These are exactly the hypotheses needed for direct-image site comparison; no closed-diagonal or separatedness assertion is used.

proof.text: Choose a finite vanishing interval for C and convert it into boundedness for the canonical t-structure. Apply [new-etale-proetale-exceptional-object-comparison] to X, which is Noetherian by step 1. Its fixed-module intrinsic constructibility criterion yields an etale object L, bounded constructible in the existing explicit-interval predicate, and an isomorphism alpha : nu_X^* L ≅ C. Extract a lower cohomological bound from the bounded-constructible property of L. This avoids the small-ring/ULift encoding of lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin.

source.place: Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived, together with Tag 09AK, lemma-compare-constructible; bounded restriction and exact cohomology comparison

proof.text: Apply [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] with coefficient ring $A=B$, input $L$, and annihilator $m$. Both schemes are finite type over the same field $k$, $B$ is finite, $mB=0$, and $m$ is invertible in $k$. That theorem explicitly permits a nonseparated $f$ and applies to the ordinary etale derived direct image. Consequently $N:=Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}L$ belongs to $D^b_c(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$.

source.place: Theorem 6.7.1 and the finite-coefficient comparison argument of Lemma 6.7.2, using the existing thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility in its main-20261015 nonseparated form

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-unbounded-direct-image-bounded-below] to f and L, using qcqs from step 1 and the lower bound from step 2. Its pullback comparison is definitionally the specified termwise comparison. Its derived adjunctions use exact left adjoints; the item uses the K-flat derived adjunctions transported to the same exact functors. Changing between adjunction structures conjugates a mate by the conjugate isomorphisms of identity transformations of the left adjoints, by mateEquiv_whiskerTop_conjugateEquiv. Consequently invertibility transfers to the exact specified component finitePushforwardDerivedComparison.app L, without altering its definition. Compose it with the direct image of alpha.hom; functors and composition preserve invertibility.

source.place: Tag 09A6, lemma-morphism-comparison; named bounded-below module mate and counit normalization as in prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image, proof, first and named-map-verification paragraphs

proof.text: Set N = Rf_et,* L, bounded constructible by step 3. The image of N under exact comparison belongs to the mapped bounded-constructible object property. Transport this membership through the isomorphism beta constructed from the specified composite of step 4. Apply [new-etale-proetale-exceptional-object-comparison] at the Noetherian scheme Y in the reverse direction to obtain intrinsic fixed-module constructibility of every output cohomology sheaf and t-structure boundedness. For lower and upper bounds c,d, choose the explicit interval [min(c,d),max(c,d)], whose endpoints are ordered even for the zero object.
